findings.ac: Exactly one module declares either canonical set (invariant 1)
findings.text: The single-declaration test in BT169_CanonicalTaxonomy.test.js fingerprints only the job-function set (files containing both 'business_ops' and 'regulatory'); nothing scans for a second CANONICAL_SECTORS declaration. api/submit.js declares its own SECTORS allowlist (9 keys, including agri_and_food and water_and_nature) and src/lib/constants.js declares a seven-key SECTORS map, so 'either canonical set' is unproven for sectors.
